ov: Small and medium-sized relatives of the kangaroo. “Wallaby” is an informal name for any macropod smaller than a kangaroo or wallaroo. Introduced populations live in New Zealand, Hawaii and the UK.
len: 45–105 cm, plus a 33–75 cm tail (brush wallabies)
rg: Australia and New Guinea; introduced to New Zealand, Hawaii and the UK.

cf.tip: “Kangaroo” means the four largest species of the family; smaller ones are usually called wallabies.

fx: There are 19 species of rock-wallaby, which live among rocks, usually near water.
